mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates monetary tightening coinciding with labor market deterioration, triggering negative equity market reactions over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts signals weakening residential demand that reduces construction sector activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production reflects strong manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5% for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP growth and decline in industrial production indicates demand-driven expansion constrained by supply chain bottlenecks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market regime, a deceleration in payroll employment below 100,000 jobs per month signals an impending slowdown in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle labor market when PAYEMS growth decelerates below 100,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
